# Pinnacle World illustrations

Three conceptual illustrations created with the built-in image-generation tool on 18 September 2026: family-journey, care-participation and connected-records.

Each is provided as a 600, 1000 and 1536 pixel-wide WebP. Preserve the 3:2 ratio and display on white. Responsive markup, descriptions and conceptual-illustration captions are generated in `scripts/world-content.cjs`.

The artwork contains no generated logos, certificates or claims. The authentic Pinnacle emblem is placed separately in HTML from the existing `brand-header.jpg`, using only its Pinnacle logo region. The illustrations do not depict documented patients, actual facilities or measured outcomes.
